nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Wave 1 & 2 of .omo/plans/rorca-remote-terminal.md.
SCOPE:
1. Create src-tauri/src/terminal/service.rs:
   - Extract TerminalService wrapping PtyManager, providing clean API:
     - list_sessions()
     - attach() / get_session()
     - write()
     - resize()
     - signal()
     - close()
2. Create src-tauri/src/terminal/output_hub.rs:
   - Bounded replay buffer (e.g. 512 KiB ~ 1 MiB ring buffer / VecDeque of bytes).
   - Multi-subscriber broadcast (tokio::sync::broadcast or equivalent lock-free/async channel) fan-out.
   - Attach logic: replay history then subscribe to live output stream.
   - Lag detection so slow subscribers do not block PTY reader.
3. Update src-tauri/src/terminal/mod.rs and src-tauri/src/ipc/terminal.rs:
   - Route existing desktop Tauri IPC commands (spawn, write, resize, signal, close, list) through TerminalService and OutputHub while preserving exact desktop behavior and safety checks.
4. Add comprehensive unit tests in src-tauri/src/terminal/tests.rs or output_hub.rs:
   - Verify multi-subscriber fanout
   - Verify slow subscriber does not block PTY pump
   - Verify history replay before live output
VERIFY: Run 'cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml' and ensure all tests pass.
STOP WHEN: Cargo tests pass with zero compiler/clippy errors and existing desktop IPC behavior is 100% preserved.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Phase 3-7 & 12 of .omo/plans/rorca-remote-terminal.md (Backend Remote Gateway).
SCOPE:
1. Update src-tauri/Cargo.toml with required dependencies (axum, tower-http, rand, sha2, tokio-tungstenite or axum ws features if needed).
2. Implement src-tauri/src/remote/ module:
   - mod.rs, server.rs, auth.rs, protocol.rs, state.rs, tailscale.rs
   - HTTP endpoints:
     - GET /api/v1/health
     - GET /api/v1/sessions (authenticated)
     - POST /api/v1/pair/exchange (pairing code exchange -> device token)
     - GET /api/v1/devices (authenticated)
     - POST /api/v1/devices/:id/revoke
     - Static file serving or fallback for Remote Web UI
   - WebSocket endpoint /api/v1/terminal/:sessionId:
     - Authenticated (bearer token or cookie or pairing token)
     - Server -> Client: binary frame with raw PTY bytes (history snapshot followed by live broadcast)
     - Client -> Server: binary frame for raw input bytes, JSON text frame for control actions (resize, signal, ping)
     - Respect device permission: 'view' vs 'control'. 'view' cannot write or signal.
   - LAN & Tailscale modes:
     - LAN mode: binds to 0.0.0.0:<port> (default off, explicit opt-in)
     - Tailscale mode: binds to 127.0.0.1:<port> only
     - Tailscale status detection (with CommandRunner trait / fake runner for tests)
3. Tauri IPC commands in src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs:
   - cmd_remote_status, cmd_remote_enable, cmd_remote_disable, cmd_remote_pairing_create, cmd_remote_devices, cmd_remote_device_revoke, cmd_tailscale_status
   - Register in src-tauri/src/lib.rs tauri invoke_handler.
4. Add comprehensive unit and integration tests:
   - Unknown session rejected
   - Unauthenticated access rejected
   - Expired pairing code rejected
   - Revoked device rejected
   - View-only permissions enforced
   - Tailscale loopback binding invariant
VERIFY: Run 'cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml' and ensure all tests pass.
STOP WHEN: All backend remote tests pass and gateway handles HTTP and WebSocket terminal streams reliably.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement Phase 8-11 & 12 of .omo/plans/rorca-remote-terminal.md (Frontend Transport, Remote Web UI, Mobile UX, Desktop Settings).
SCOPE:
1. Create ui/src/lib/terminalTransport/:
   - types.ts (TerminalTransport interface: listSessions, attach, write, resize, interrupt, onOutput, onLifecycle)
   - tauriTransport.ts (Desktop Tauri implementation using existing invoke / listen)
   - remoteTransport.ts (WebSocket implementation for remote browser)
2. Refactor ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx & TerminalSplitView.tsx:
   - Use TerminalTransport abstraction so TerminalPane is transport-agnostic.
   - Ensure existing desktop experience has zero regressions.
3. Create ui/src/remote/:
   - RemoteApp.tsx (standalone remote web app entry / router)
   - PairingPage.tsx (handle QR code fragment #pair=<secret>, exchange token, store session)
   - RemoteSessionList.tsx (display active sessions, connection status)
   - RemoteTerminal.tsx (xterm terminal attached via WebSocket)
   - Mobile special-key bar (Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows, Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D quick buttons)
   - Responsive touch handling and ResizeObserver fit
4. Update Desktop Settings in ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx:
   - Add 'Remote Access' section/tab:
     - Enable / Disable switch
     - Mode selection: Tailscale vs Local Network
     - QR code display / URL copy for pairing
     - Authorized devices list with Revoke button
     - Tailscale status helper
5. Add unit and component tests in ui/src/:
   - Test TerminalTransport abstraction
   - Test RemoteApp, PairingPage, and RemoteTerminal
   - Ensure existing desktop tests in 'bun run test' all pass.
VERIFY: Run 'bun run test' and 'bun run build' in ui/.
STOP WHEN: Both 'bun run test' and 'bun run build' succeed with 0 failures and zero LSP diagnostics.
